annotations.title: Property history and current listing status

description:
Shown in the property report as the 'Property history and current listing
status' card in the Valuation part of the Market section.

Most-recent Sold or For Sale record. A For Sale record's price is the
advertised price, null when the ad gave none (e.g. "contact agent"), so
the newest record can be an unpriced listing: the last completed sale is
the newest `type: "Sold"` row in `/sale-history`.

**Price: 10¢ per call.**
name: properties_sale_history_latest
